data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included adverse prior year development of GBP 11.6m (2018: favourable development of GBP 8.5m) following loss reserve strengthening in the Treaty Property and Third-party Liability classes.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 203.101m. Using the gross claims development table, prior year development at 31 December 2019 is calculated as a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 12.79m (6.3% of opening gross claims), driven by loss reserve strengthening principally in treaty property and thirdparty liability exposures. The income statement notes an adverse prior year development of GBP 11.6m net of reinsurance, consistent with gross adverse movement identified in the claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included adverse prior year development of GBP 11.6m (2018: favourable development of GBP 8.5m) following loss reserve strengthening in the Treaty Property and Third-party Liability classes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Claims Outstanding table (page 24). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was provided; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 43) per the rules. Income statement provides only net prior year adverse development (GBP 11.6m net), which is consistent with the gross triangle-based calculation. Amounts in the triangle are presented in thousands; prior year development reported here is converted to millions. No explicit split of the gross PYD by line of business was disclosed, so LOB amounts are null.
